params_doc.params: extra parameters specific to the exchange API endpoint  EXCHANGE SPECIFIC PARAMETERS
params_doc.params.address: Can be used for filtering transactions by specific address or memo.
params_doc.params.addresses: Can be used for filtering transactions by specific addresses or memos (max: 20).
params_doc.params.offset: If you want the request to return entries starting from a particular line, you can use OFFSET clause to tell it where it should start. Default: 0, Min: 0, Max: 10000
params_doc.params.status: Can be used for filtering transactions by status codes. Caution: You must use this parameter with appropriate transactionMethod and use valid status codes for this method. You can find them below. Example: "status": [3,7]
params_doc.params.transactionMethod: Method. Example: 1 to display deposits / 2 to display withdraws. Do not send this parameter in order to receive both deposits and withdraws.
params_doc.params.uniqueId: Can be used for filtering transactions by specific unique id
params_doc.since: timestamp in ms of the earliest deposit/withdrawal, default is undefined
